text:
```yaml
name: Claude Issue Triage
on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]

jobs:
  triage-issue:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Setup Claude Code Environment
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-base-action@beta
        id: claude
        with:
          prompt: |
            You are an AI assistant helping with issue triage for the Claude Agent SDK Python repository. 
            Analyze the issue content and apply appropriate labels based on the following criteria:
            
            Label categories:
            - bug: If the issue describes a bug or unexpected behavior
            - enhancement: If the issue suggests a feature improvement or new functionality
            - documentation: If the issue is about documentation problems or improvements
            - question: If the issue is asking for help or clarification
            - support: If the issue is requesting support or assistance
            - good first issue: If the issue is suitable for newcomers
            
            Please analyze the issue title and body, then suggest appropriate labels.
            
            Issue Title: ${{ github.event.issue.title }}
            Issue Body: ${{ github.event.issue.body }}
            
            Respond with only the labels you recommend, separated by commas (e.g., "bug, high priority").
          allowed_tools: |
            [
              "github_issue_search",
              "github_issue_get",
              "github_issue_list_labels"
            ]
          mcp_config: |
            {
              "server": "github://mcp-server",
              "token": "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}",
              "repo": "${{ github.repository }}"
            }
          model: "claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620"
          timeout_minutes: 5

      - name: Apply Labels
        uses: actions-ecosystem/action-add-labels@v1
        if: steps.claude.outputs.conclusion == 'success'
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          labels: ${{ steps.claude.outputs.execution_file }}
```
